meta.title: Sally's Cupcakes (Create not Learn)
meta.description: Cupcake shop for user testing. Create not Learn variant: enables the Gutenberg Extensible Site Editor and Omnibar experiments and lands on the v2 editor. Pair with &gutenberg-pr=79549.
meta.author: scruffian

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Create not Learn (Gutenberg PR #79549) lives behind two experiments.
// Set last so nothing earlier in the blueprint can clobber the option.
update_option( 'gutenberg-experiments', array(
	'gutenberg-extensible-site-editor' => true,
	'gutenberg-omnibar'                => true,
) );
